blockade.prompt: Equirectangular 360 panorama of open outer space: only stars and glowing gas in every direction, above and below, no surface anywhere. A far-off spiral vortex of cyan and magenta plasma like a wormhole, small in the distance, violet nebula haze around it, dense sharp stars, the band of a galaxy crossing the view. Mostly deep black. Retro synthwave palette, high contrast.
